balls.text: fullish, White drags it to deep midwicket for couple of runs. DK fumbles to make that second run easier to get
He will get just a single, down to long-off.
backs away to drive this to long-off for a single. Finally Shikhar is on strike
Dropped by McLaren Tough chance this. He moved from long-on to catch the lofted hit and dived forward but couldn't hold on
Full delivery, White drills it towards the straight boundary, Shaun Marsh rushes across from long-off and makes a fine diving save
yorker from Harris, dug out back down the track.
Cleaned that up. He moved down the track, backed away, got it on the full and crashes it to the cover  boundary
not quite an yorker but White mishits the drive down to long-on
yet another yorker, good over so far, squeezed out to covers
slower one, on a length, pushed away to the on side for a single
another yorker, dug out to cover point
goes for the yorker, squeezed out to covers
The long hops keep coming and the batsmen are missing out. THis was very short and a surprised White plays a tennis smash and finds long-on
shorter, quicker, cut to cover point. Dhawan should have done better than that. No one at the deep on the off side but he played a very tame cut
full toss but White whips it straight to deep midwicket.
taps this through midwicket and will pick up couple of runs. Nicely done. Lots of vacant real estate in that area
drags this from outside off to long-on for a single
Bosh! Shikhar leaned forward to swing this high over cowcorner.
fullish and around off stump, driven past his partner, Marsh comes around from long-off to intercept
almost yorker length, pushed out to cover point
around the off stump line, nudged to right of backward point for a single
Almost decapitates his partner! Shikhar leans forward and crashes this length delivery in the air and his partner just about manages to duck out of the way
Skillful! he backed away and steered the length delivery between backward point and third man. Nicely done.
shortish ball outside off, Duminy flat-bats it towards mid-off where Shaun Marsh pouches it.
floated full outside off, very full, Shikhar is late in trying to drive it away but gets a lucky inside edge and the ball races past Gilly
Duminy rotates the strike with a gentle drive to long-on
drives this down to the long-on
lands outside off and turns in. Shikhar goes for the reverse sweep but misses out. It hit him on his pad and they go up in appeal. It was turned down as he was hit outside off stump
Swipe away! He fetched it from around off and swung it to the square-leg boundary. Crashed
gets down the track to drive it to long-on
late cuts this to short third man region for a single
Another googly, lands outside leg, moves past the sweep and bounds off the pad
Whackity whack! In some style. He moved down the track and wristed this googly almost nonchalantly over long-on
googly around off stump, swept to deep midwicket
Mowed away! He went down on his knee and slog swept this to the square-leg boundary
moves down the track to ping long-off
taps this to backward point region for a single
drives this down the track
leans forward to drive to long-off
leans forward to tuck this through  midwicket for a single

Some one has held a catch. No seriously. Really. Truly. Unbelievable.  It was wristed away towards deep midwicket, the bottom-hand working overtime, and Abhishek pouches it and throws the ball in the air
Dropped by Ryan Harris Again. Gilly adjusts his helmet. Preity Zinta can't believe it. It was swung straight to Harris at long-on. What a clanger!
googly outside off, cut away to deep point region for couple of runs
laps this to midwicket region for a single
Crash! Nicely done. It was shorter and outside off, Ravi Teja leaned back, reached out and cut it to the backward point boundary

More fun! This was tossed up on the middle and leg line and Teja just leans forward to crash this over long-on. 50 up for Teja, who will be remembered from hitting Glen McGrath for a stunning six over point in the first edition
Ravi Teja goes down town. he sashayed down the track and lifted this flighted delivery, with the turn, over long-off
low full toss but swept straight to deep backward square-leg. Shikhar is not too happy with himself. And rightfully so. He should have whacked it to the boundayr
paddles this through backward square-leg region
gets forward to drive the full delivery from outside off to long-on
leans forward to drive this to covers
works this away for a single

Dropped by Ryan Harris mid-on. Ravi Teja went for the big hoick to the on side and top edged it to left of mid-on. Harris moved to his left, settled under it and went with the Australian style of catching and clanged it! What a day Punjab have had on field. Miserable
full and straight, driven to long-on for a single

Deliberately done this time. it's a length delivery outside off and Ravi leaned forward, opened the bat-face and glided it through vacant slips for a four. Wry smile from Mclaren; he obviously thought that was an edge. Hopefully they will show a replay.
slasher Teja! It was a short ball outside off and Ravi topedges the cut to third man boundary

on the pads, Rav misses out. The ball bounds off the pad. They go for the single and McLaren does a Brett Lee. He rushes forward, slides, picks up the ball, turns and fires a direct hit at the non-striker's end. The bat was dragged back inside the crease and then lifted up in the air when the ball hit the stumps. They didn't go upstairs.Drama Gilchrist now walks up the umpire. Nope. Nothing changes. Bowl the next ball.
fullish, on the middle and off, Ravi tries to work it to the leg side and edges it uppishly to left of cover
taps this to extra cover for a single
NIcerly! It's a low dipping full toss and Shikhar leans forward to caress it through wide mid-off region.

slightly short in length, coming in from outside off, Teja goes for another pull and fails to connect. It hits him on the body as he went down on his knee to play that shot and the bowler shouts for lbw. Gilly doesn't. The umpire hands the cap back to Paul
fullish outside off, driven to short extra cover
slower one, full and outside off, dragged down to long-on
goes for a big pull but doesn't connect properly and mishits it past midwicket
flicks this through to deep midwicket for a single
slower one, full and outside off, Shikhar tries to swipe it to the on side but fails to connect.
a long hop but Shikhar can only manage to drag-pull it to left of midwicket
works this to short fine-leg
leans forward to steer this through point
dropped by Chawla Not easy. Ravi Teja went down the track and drilled it hard to left of Piyush who went with both hands but it burst through his palms
plays the reverse paddle but pats it straight to short third man. And it was a full toss. Hmmm
skips down the track and drives down to long-on
slower one, full and around off, turned through midwicket
full and just outside off, steered to short third man
leans forward to drive down to long-off
takes this from outside off and whips it to deep midwicket
And again on the pads, dragged to left of short fine-leg where PK makes a diving stop. Else a four.
leans forward to push it back to the bowler
Punjab continue to bowl around the leg side and sometimes even down the leg. This one is a wide down the leg and it runs past Gilly, who is up to the stumps
rushes down the track, reaches forward and drives it to the off side of the pitch but his partner is unable to get away in time. The ball ricochets of Ravi Teja
googly on the off and middle, pushed out to cover point
cut away to the off for a single
Mandeep Singh makes a right royal mess at deep midwicket. Chawla drags this very short and its been pulled to deep midwicket region where Mandeep messes up
leans forward to defend the leg break to the off side
floated full outside leg stump, he doesn't connect with the sweep and Gilly can't collect it cleanly
gets back to turn it to left of short third man for a single
slightly short in length, pulled through midwicket
Wallop! It was delivered from round the stumps but Shikhar doesn't mind the change of the angle. He leans forward to thump it on the up to the straight boundary
full delivery around off , squeezed out to point
leans forward to drive this to mid-on
Crashed. He leaned forward and across to drive it hard through covers. The fielder got some hand on it but it was struck too hard.
stays back to work it to the on side for a single
short in length and outside off, Ravi Teja whipped it, wristed it, to the right of mid-off where the fielder dives to make a half-stop.
outside the off stump, mishit to covers
shorter in length, punched back to PK who throws it back and down the leg side but Gilly moves quickly to pouch it!
Gilchrist is standing up to the stumps now and he reaches well outside off to collect this wide
just outside off stump finally and Shikhar edges the intended drive to his pad
Hmm.... if this is a plan, its going pretty bad. yet again, they bowl at the pads of Shikhar, who clips it to the backward square-leg boundary
this time its PK who pings the pad and Shikhar glances it to the fine-leg boundary
he rushed down the track and you know the rest of the drill! Upto the pitch of the ball and drove it to the straight boundary
moves down the track and hits it to the right of the bowler who lunges out to make a half-stop.
slower this time and Shikhar defends down the track
Crunched! He fetched the full delivery from outside off and swept it really hard to the square-leg boundary
on the middle, Ravi goes back to punch it wide of mid-on
on the middle and leg, and some turn there, Teja gets a leading edge to covers
Edged  but safe. It moved away in the air, from leg to off, and Shikhar, who was trying to work the ball to midwicket, got a leading edge to cover point but it fell clear of Paul
walks down the track and jabs the incoming delivery to the on side for a single

full in length outside off and Teja was shaping for the cut or the steer to third man when he was surprised by the extent to which the ball cut back in. He was cramped for room and stabbed the ball to the off
taps this to cover point for a single
not all that short and it was on the middle and off but Shikhar managed to cover the line and pull it up and over midwicket
in the zone outside off, run down to third man for a single
fullish, around off stump line, driven straight to mid-off
And yet again. Full and on the pads. Shikhar misses out again but the ball runs off the pad to fine-leg boundary
again on the pads, runs to fine-leg region
Succeeds this time. It was fuller and on the leg stump line and Shikhar whips it to the left of mid-on
full in length ,lands on the leg stump and hits the pad. Dhawan was looking to mow it across the line
Almost carries to third man! Frenetic action so far. Teja chased it well outside off and slashed it towards third man but it fell short of the advancing fielder
moves away from Dhawan who pushes it back to the bowler
taps this to the on side for a single

dropped by Paul Valthathy PK got it to straighten outside off from short of length and Teja top-edged the pull just over square-leg. Paul got in time and made a real mess of it. He dived after he dropped the ball. Poor effort.
cuts in from the off and middle, moves past the prod and bounds off the pad
stays back to push this length delivery to the off side

One slip in place. Run out chance missed It was tapped towards short mid-off and he charged across. Ryan McLaren intercepted from covers, picked the ball, and flicked it, underarmed even as he flung himself forward. had he hit, the batsman would have been a goner.

Bhatt is run out. The slower one was pushed to the off side of the pitch, Anand got to it and found the stumps at the striker's end. Punjab's dreams evaporate into the hills of Mcleodganj. Good brave effort from them at the end of the tournament and they nearly sneaked through. But that's that. Some joy for Deccan.
Smoked! He fetches the short delivery from outside off and absolutely thumps it over midwicket boundary with a crushing pull shot . Gilchrist smiles!
in the zone outside off stump, swing and a miss

Folks see the highlights. Joy and agony for Duminy! Piyush lashed this high towards cover boundary. Duminy ran to his left, then realised it was going over him, back pedaled and lunged back to catch it but fell on the ropes!
cuts in towards middle stump, Piyush defends
from round the stumps, short-pitched stuff and it flies over the blade
What does Amit need to do get this wicket?! Another googly and the batsman is all at sea again. Kedar takes this one as well
quicker, a leg break this time and he is beaten again, on the forward lunge. Kedar likes to stump! He keeps taking off the bails. he has been good behind the stumps today
googly from round the stumps and he has no clue. He went back and tried to jab out at it. Kedar collects
lunges forward to defend but the ball slides away from the off stump and away from the edge. Kedar whips off the bails
leans forward to nudge to the on side
Clatter! The googly again. it was tossed up full outside off and Praveen goes for a slog over mid-on. The ball broke back in to hit the off stump
the slower bouncer and a surprised PK just about, almost comically, stabs it behind square-leg.  Steyn and Praveen have a laugh over it
yorker on the middle stump line, Praveen manages to dig it out in time
moves outside leg and hits the full delivery to mid-off
banged in short on the off stump line, PK taps it down to the off side
full and straight, on the off, pushed out to cover
fullish and outside off, steered to backward point
gets back to defend this back to the bowler

Hattrick for Amit! He is beyond joy. And is mobbed by his team-mates. It was the googly that bounced extra even as it broke in from outside off and Harris was cramped as he went for the cut. They had the second slip/gully for this hat-trick delivery and it flew to him. Good sharp catch. Amit hops in joy

Stumped! Amit Mishra has bowled really well today. This one was tossed up and the batsman was lured into coming down the track. But the ball dipped rapidly, gripped the surface and spun past the waft. Kedar Devdhar removes the bails in a flash
He tries to slog sweep this googly but doesn't find much wood behind it. Dan Christian charges forward from deep midwicket and lunges forward to take a very good low catch
Shout for lbw. Fullish on the middle and leg stump line, goes for the sweep and is hit on the pad
leg break on the middle and leg, swept away to long-leg
backs away to hit it hard to sweeper cover
on the off stump line, stabbed back to the bowler
And Mandeep pats this to fine-leg boundary. Full and going down the leg, lapped around the corner

lifter, he goes for the pull but misses out as it was the slow bouncer. The ball lands on the right shoulder and then hits the helmet grill and almost rolls back to the stumps. Christian checks with the batsman if he is ok and pats him
slower one, short in length around off, cut to left of point
rushes down the track and has a slog. No wood on leather.
fetches it from outside off stump, and drags it to deep midwicket
on the middle and leg, dabbed to the on side
leans forward to drive this back to the bowler
Ojha pumps his fist. Abhishek went down the track and swung it straight to deep midwicket. Punjab's dreams are evaporating in the hills
slightly short in length, pulled to deep midwicket
goes for the sweep but doesn't connect properly
punches this one out to long-off
works this through the on side for a single
leans forward to jab this one away
gets a leading edge to cover point, trying to dab this to the on side

shout for lbw. Close. It was delivered from round the stumps, lands on the middle and off and turned. The batsman failed to connect with the reverse sweep. Replays suggest it would have hit the top of the off stump
floated full outside leg stump, worked down to short fine-leg for a single
Ah! a lovely delivery. He slowed up the pace on this one and that did the trick. The batsman couldn't adjust to the slower pace and jabbed out at it. The keeper collects
googly that lands outside off and breaks away. The batsman didn't pick it and ended up stabbing it. Mishra smiles!
turns this form around off and middle line to midwicket
flighted outside off, pushed out to extra cover
on the pads, turned to midwicket
flighted outside off, driven to long-on
Caught at the deep point boundary! it was short and wide, DK reached out to cut. The ball flew towards the point boundary where Ravi Teja calmly puts his hands up to pouch it.
slower one, on middle and off, tapped down to third man
Game over? Gilly is gone. It was a full delivery outside off and Gilchrist went for his off drive. It was very full and he couldn't quite get his timing right. And hit it straight to extra cover

slower one, a lot closer to the off, cut out to point. Gilchrist rushes across, the throw comes and misses the stumps. had it hit the stumps at the non-striker's end, Gilchrist would have been run out. He gets to his 50 as he comes back for the overthrows.
Bang!  It was a length delivery outside off and Gilchrist smashed it - almost flat-batted- past the extra cover fielder
from round the stumps, just outside off, Gilchrist tries to late cut but misses

Shout for a catch but turned down. It was the googly and Dk went for the sweep. I would like to see a replay as I thought it went off the bottom edge and off the boot/pad and popped up on the leg side for a catch to the keeper. Hope they show one.
full and on the leg stump line, quicker, Gilchrist goes for the sweep but it rolls off his pad.
another fine delivery. Gilchrist came down the track but was beaten in flight; he adjusted and lunged out to jab it through midwicket
full and outside off, swept to deep midwicket. Just a single. Good over so far. Gily on strike now. Can he get after Amit?
quickish skidder on the middle stump line, punched through wide midwicket
tossed it up really full, Gilchrist digs it out back down the track
just a single down to sweeper cover. Good over from JPD
gets back to whip this to deep midwicket region
short in length, cut away to the deep point
clips this to deep midwicket for a single

big shout for lbw as Gilchrist was struck on the pad, trying to clip it to the on side.  It landed on the leg and middle and drifted towards leg. Perhaps, it would have missed leg. It was one of those deliveries. Replays in: It shows it landed on leg and middle and would have hit the top of the leg stump
goes down the track and steers it through point to hand over the strike to Gilchrist
turns away from a length, cut to deep point
on the middle and leg, turned to deep square-leg for a single
Er .. Don't bowl full to Gilly! What a utterly butterly delicious shot. He leaned forward to swing it so cleanly over midwicket boundadry.
Don't bowl short to Gilly. He pressed back and crash-pulled the quicker delivery to the midwicket boundary.
full in length and outside off, punched out to sweeper cover
tries to sweep this but misses and the ball hits the pad
Clobbered! This was a long hop almost and Gilchrist jumps at it. Fierce pull. Four!
short of length delivery and Gilchrist decides to go for the pull. He mishits it and it just about clears midwicket.
from round the stumps now, full in length and outside off, Gilchrist bottom edges the cut and the ball rolls behind
in the zone outside off, run down to third man
And again. DK tries to get down the track and is beaten comprehensively, pushing inside the line
beaten this time! DK leans across and has a lame poke at this one
full and wide outside off. DK tries to chase it but can't reach
lands on the middle and leg and skids on to hit the pad. Gilly was trying to turn it to square-leg
retreats inside the crease and pulls it to the square-leg boundary. Crashed.
gets back to turn this to square-leg fielder
presses back to turn this to midwicket for a single
Reverse slap! DK fetches this from outside off and reverse swept it past the slip and to the left of backward point
Lovely delivery that drifted in towards middle, landed on a good length and spun sharply past the defensive poke
coming in from outside off, Gilchrist mistimes the cut and the ball rolls out to point
good-length delivery around off stump, pushed out to point
Too full. Whack. Gilchrist crashed this full delivery over the bowler's head. Preity Zinta waves the flag.
lands on a good length outside off and comes in with that round-the-stump angle; pushed out to mid-on
Crushed! Gilchrist leaned forward to lift this length delivery over long-off. Sliced up and over.
on the off and middle line, from the good length and Gilchrist defends it back to the bowler. He then walks down the track for some gardening
wide delivery, from round the stumps. Way outside the off stump.

. dropped by Steyn The new angle almost works. He hurled this full and straight , and slightly slower, and Gilly mishit the on-the-up drive over Steyn who got both hands to it but the ball burst through the palms
This one is a proper bouncer and on the leg stump line. Gilchrist allows it to sail over and then suggests to the ump that he thought it was a wide down the leg. think it went over the leg stump.
Another short delivery and Gilchrist is beaten for pace. He ends up top edging his pull but clears midwicket.
Another screamer, lifting delivery in the channel outside off and Gilchrist drops his wrists, gets his bat out of the way and sways away. Game on!
fires a bouncer and Gilly ducks. he then marks his guard with his boot.
lovely delivery, lands on a length around off and seams in towards off and middle, defended back down the track

Shaun goes. Punjab stutter. DC camp is delirious. Shaun Marsh went down the track  looking for the big hit but was beaten in flight. He tried to go through with the shot but edged a simple catch to short third man.
leans forward, fetches this from outside off and drags it to wide midwicket boundary.
reaches outside off and carves this short of length delivery up and over cover point
around the off stump, short in length ,cut straight to point
floated on the off, pushed out to point
fine delivery this: curving in towards the off stump and Shaun defends.
Wham! Full and wide outside off and Shaun Marsh reaches out to cream it through covers. He went down on his knee to play that shot

Steyn takes out Paul. He hurled this one fuller and on the middle stump line. It landed around leg and middle and curved towards middle. Paul isn't too good with that line as he tends to get cramped up. And he gave a dolly of a catch to mid-on, trying to whip it to the on side.
Biff! He missed out on two previous occasions but not this time. He leaned across and carved the short delivery up and over point
And again
curves away from the off stump line, Paul has a go at it but doesn't connect
It wasn't all that short and it was almost on the off stump line but Gilchrist pressed back, waited, and cut it late to the right of backward point. Very nicely done.
this is a lot straighter on the off stump line, pushed down to mid-on
And again. There was some width on offer but Gilly couldn't find the gap
outside off, cut away but straight to backward point
on the leg stump line, Paul stays adjacent to the line and punches it to long-off. White has a chat with the bowler as Gilly takes guard
from round the stumps, on the pads but Paul mistimes his sweep to short fine
